stackDivergence.rationale: Native owner boundaries, complete token/namespace identities and original factory generators are retained. Browser maps, immutable lexical URI strings and byte arrays bind generated gperf/UTF8/component transport; actual existing OOXMLValue/UNO/RTL/SAX owners provide typed conversions and model dispatch.

preservedResponsibilities: Original three consumed XFastTokenHandler lexical operations delegate to the shared original TokenMap owner and return exact native token IDs. Byte arrays bind UTF8 input/output values. Complete service information/registration and generated UNO interface/lifetime are omitted, not simulated.
omittedResponsibilities: Unconsumed native interfaces, component services, C++ ABI and native memory/thread/performance contracts remain outside this consumed binding.
Document/style/list/table/section/theme SAX contexts, complete canonical DOCX model import/export and existing UI integration remain pending in V4DQJW.
